hints.title: Prerequisite Topological Dependency Obstacle
hints.text: Prerequisite ordering mandates resolving dependencies before courses. When cyclic dependencies exist, no valid linear order covers all courses. How can uncovering elements with zero pending prerequisites produce a valid path?

hints.title: Zero Indegree Extraction Invariant
hints.text: In a directed acyclic graph, at least one node has zero incoming edges. Peeling away free nodes progressively unlocks dependent nodes.

hints.title: Indegree Reduction Traversal Procedure
hints.text: Track prerequisite counts for all courses and collect courses with count zero. For each ready course, decrement dependent courses and unlock any reaching zero. If the total recorded courses matches numCourses, return the accumulated sequence, otherwise return an empty array.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Every course and prerequisite dependency edge is processed at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all permutations takes O(V!) time which immediately times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency list and indegree buffer require O(V + E) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Detecting directed cycles while generating a valid topological ordering.
